description: pixel art landscape, the milky way as the road of souls in slavic myth: a long glowing bridge of starlight crossing the dark void of space, floating rocks drifting beside it, clouds of star dust and distant spiral galaxies, a faint glowing gate far away at the end of the bridge, wide panorama for a dim background behind text, low contrast, very dark muted palette of deep space blue, violet and pale starlight silver, no text, no border, no people in front, no animals in front
